scope: Illustrative commercial label and price research only. Neither a shopping recommendation nor a clinical ranking. Three prenatal options, one moisturizer, one binder. Full product library, all ingredients, current lot-specific recalls and certification directory audit remain open.
rules: Keep product facts separate from clinical evidence and claims. No affiliate links, sponsored placement, or score implying pregnancy safety.
Use exact brand, country, SKU, serving count, label version, date, label URL, ingredient form and units. Use null if absent or not extracted; distinguish unlisted from confirmed zero.
Compare cost per full serving, not tablet count. Track promotions separately; refresh before display.
Never equate percent DV, RDA/AI, supplement dose or UL. Total diet, age, medical diagnoses and multiple gestation matter. Preserve folic acid vs DFE vs methylfolate distinctions.

Quality certification is not proof of efficacy or FDA premarket approval; verify current certifier directory and exact SKU. Check FDA recall archive and lot number; lack of a search result is not clearance.
Pregnancy/lactation product eligibility must be separately reviewed, even if ingredients are familiar. Keep label information and clinician guidance separate.
